title: Rules.
bodyText: The state agency and the statewide health coordinating council may adopt necessary rules for the purposes of this chapter in accordance with chapter 91.
bodyHtml: §323D-62  Rules.  The state agency and the statewide health coordinating council may adopt necessary rules for the purposes of this chapter in accordance with chapter 91. [L 1975, c 159, pt of §2; am L 1977, c 178, pt of §2; am L 1980, c 75, §25]
